mapper.select: SELECT c.class_id AS classId, f.file_url AS fileUrl, u.name AS userId, c.class_title AS classTitle, c.class_price AS classPrice FROM class c LEFT JOIN file f ON c.file_no = f.file_no INNER JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.class_permit = 'Y';

SELECT c.class_id AS classId, f.file_url AS fileUrl, u.name AS userId, c.class_title AS classTitle, c.class_price AS classPrice FROM class c LEFT JOIN file f ON c.file_no = f.file_no INNER JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE (c.class_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.class_price LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.class_category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.class_level LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND c.class_permit = 'Y';

SELECT c.class_id AS classId, c.class_title AS title, u.name AS instructor, c.class_price AS price, f.file_url AS fileUrl, c.description AS description, c.class_category AS classCategory, c.class_recom AS classRecom, c.class_level AS classLevel, COALESCE(up.user_count, 0) AS studentCount FROM class c LEFT JOIN file f ON c.file_no = f.file_no INNER JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count FROM user_payment_history GROUP BY class_id ) up ON c.class_id = up.class_id WHERE c.class_id = #{id};
